episodes.synopsis: High school girl Ruri meets graduate student Nagi while collecting minerals in the mountains.
episodes.title: My First Mineral Hunt

episodes.synopsis: Ruri is determined to find gold, but Nagi explains that it might not be as likely as she hopes.
episodes.title: The Value of Golden Color

episodes.synopsis: Ruri meets Nagi's colleague Imari, and the three embark on a journey to find a lost mine.
episodes.title: The Lost Planet

episodes.synopsis: In search of sapphire, Nagi teaches Ruri how to study sand, but Ruri prefers to hunt on a bigger scale.
episodes.title: Study of Sands

episodes.synopsis: Ruri, Nagi, and Imari head to the beach in search of agate, and Ruri learns about the long lifecycle of rocks.
episodes.title: Worlds Seen and Unseen

episodes.synopsis: Just as the group begins searching for sapphire on foot, Ruri uncovers a grave mistake that halts their plans.
episodes.title: A Closer Look into the Blue

episodes.synopsis: Ruri finds sea glass on the beach and runs into her classmate Shoko, who has a secret passion for minerals.
episodes.title: Seaside Recycling Studio

episodes.synopsis: Ruri teams up with Shoko for a science project, which takes a turn when they discover a strange, orange rock.
episodes.title: The Golden Elegy

episodes.synopsis: Ruri and Nagi head out to hunt for opals but discover that the area has already been fully excavated.
episodes.title: Time Capsule of 1.9 Million Tons

episodes.synopsis: Imari leads a hunt for manganese ore, when the group encounters a mystery along abandoned railroad tracks.
episodes.title: Sentence to an Abandoned Railroad

episodes.synopsis: When Ruri has trouble deciding on her future, she turns to her study of sapphire.
episodes.title: The Sapphire Cradle

episodes.synopsis: When Ruri discovers her grandpa's old crystal radio, she's determined to restore it.
episodes.title: Memories Come with Rocks and Noise

episodes.synopsis: Ruri, Shoko, Nagi, and Imari take a trip together, where they search for meteorite at a hot springs inn.
episodes.title: Look Up, Examine, Search! And Next!
